title: A.R.M.O.R. command to the switch of an electrical node
description: A command to one switch of one ARMOR-ELECTRICAL node, published by the server to armor/electrical/{node_id}/command (never retained). Only these actions exist. Closing is two steps: `arm` (the node answers with a one-time `token`), then `close_a` or `close_b` carrying that token within ten seconds; the token is what stops an old message from closing anything. `open` and `acknowledge` carry no token. `open` is always accepted; a node without switching enabled refuses the rest.

command_id.description: Chosen by the server; the node repeats it in its result.

switch.description: The id of one of the node's switches (the `id` in its state message).

token.description: Only on close_a and close_b: the token the node gave in the result of the arm.
